story: The opening hour was fast, with UAE controlling the peloton to allow Narváez to win the first intermediate sprint. Sütterlin then attacked, joined by four riders including Veistroffer. The pace subsequently eased, with Soudal Quick-Step limiting the gap to 1:30. EF increased the tempo on the main climb, allowing Max Walker to bridge across. UAE failed to catch the break before the final intermediate sprint. Soudal Quick-Step then regained control, catching the escapees with 15 kilometres remaining. Magnier crashed in the final kilometre, also hindering Biesterbos, allowing Fretin to sprint to victory.
